concept.title: Progress from to-dos and sub-tasks
concept.shortdesc: A task's progress is worked out, so it never goes stale:

strow.stentry: Is in Done on the board
The share of its to-dos ticked off, with each sub-task counting by its own progress
0% until it is moved to Done

conbody.p: A to-do added on a task is one of the project's to-dos: the To-dos page lists it with the others, and ticking it off in either place moves the task's bar. A task with two of its four to-dos ticked is 50%; a task with one finished sub-task and one at 50% is 75%.
